Client-facing Implementation Consultant with 3+ years of experience delivering enterprise SaaS implementations, customer onboarding, spend and financial workflow optimization, client training, and go-live success for Fortune 500 organizations.

At HighRadius, I led multiple end-to-end implementations, increased automation from 42% to 70% on key workflows, and recovered a high-risk Cash Application engagement from red to green in under a month.

Currently pursuing an MS in Business Analytics and Information Management at Purdue University’s Daniels School of Business, with a banking analytics practicum at Community First Bank of Indiana.

Open to Implementation Consultant, Solutions Consultant, and Professional Services roles. Open to relocation.
